zones.csv.chart: sas (own flights, one way) or partner (round trip)

partners.csv.status: online | online-double | phone | earn | ended | unsettled | not-ticketed
partners.csv.source: public page the status rests on
partners.csv.source_date: date of that source, if it has one
partners.csv.evidence: A (SAS or the airline) | B (SAS customer service in writing) | C (press, schedules) | D (community, booking reports); D+D = two independent
partners.csv.verification: verified (A) | reported | disputed | unsettled - never SAS's position unless A
partners.csv.reports: how many member booking reports back the row (a count only)
partners.csv.checked: date Dotflight last checked this row
